text:
jamie: Heads-up — starting planning for a discovery endpoint that advertises model surface + capability flags. Need a small API contract to unblock platform + SDK teams.

jamie: Goals: 1) expose supported features (streaming, tool-calls, structured-output), 2) token limits and preferred model variants, 3) per-feature stability notes (beta/ga), 4) machine-readable so SDKs can adapt.

sasha: 👍 do we include latency/cost tiers or just binary flags?

jamie: Prefer flags + soft hints. e.g. supports_streaming: true, streaming_latency_hint: "low". Keep cost estimates out of discovery for now (privacy + churn).

dave: From model onboarding: we also need to advertise which tool schemas are supported (e.g. calculator, browser, retriever) and whether tool calls are sync/async. Otherwise client lib will mis-handle fallback.

olivia: UX note: prefer a conservative contract so older SDKs don't break. If we add new flags, they should default to false. Also include a version field and schema_url for validation.

jamie: Agree. Proposed minimal shape (machine-readable) — placeholder example:

```
{
  "model": "redwood-large-v1",
  "model_family": "redwood-large",
  "version": "2026-03-01",
  "capabilities": {
    "chat": true,
    "completions": true,
    "embeddings": false,
    "rerank": true,
    "streaming": true,
    "structured_output": true,
    "tool_calls": true
  },
  "tools": [
    {"name":"browser","calls":"sync"},
    {"name":"retriever","calls":"async"},
    {"name":"calculator","calls":"sync"}
  ],
  "limits": {
    "max_context_tokens": 8192,
    "max_generation_tokens": 2048
  },
  "stability": {
    "streaming": "ga",
    "tool_calls": "beta",
    "structured_output": "ga"
  },
  "schema_url": "https://redwood.example/schemas/model-discovery-v1.json"
}
```

sasha: Nice. Few implementation Qs: where lives this endpoint? /models/:id/discovery or /discovery? Also caching TTL—should be relatively long to avoid perf hit.

jamie: Plan: /models/:id/discovery under the public API. Cache TTL per-model, default 1h, override via Cache-Control. SDKs should fetch on startup and respect ETag.

dave: If tool schema changes (e.g., new tool fields) we must bump version. Include schema_url + version for clients to validate.

olivia: For streaming flags, client libs need to handle partial vs chunked events. Add a streaming_mode hint: "chunked" | "event" | "none".

jamie: Good call. I'll add streaming_mode to the spec. Also adding recommended_fallback_variant for constrained environments (e.g., quantized variant id).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: design doc stub created by jamie at https://redwood.internal/docs/model-discovery.123 :rocket:

sasha: Next steps: jamie to draft formal API spec + example responses, dave to add model onboarding checklist updates, olivia to mock SDK UX changes. Sync Thurs 10am.

jamie: I'll post the spec in the doc and ping here when ready. @sasha @dave @olivia thanks. :thumbsup:
